complaint: A reader notes the Battle of Hastings article claims our correspondent was present.
reply: Fish News stands by its reporting.

complaint: A reader points out that Chunce Whatney cannot have interviewed both sides of the tournament final, since he was reportedly filing from a different continent at the time.
reply: Fish News notes that Mr Whatney's whereabouts are a matter for Mr Whatney, not for readers.

complaint: A serving officer writes to say he was quoted at length on a matter he was never asked about.
reply: The quote remains accurate in spirit, which Fish News considers the more important kind of accuracy.

complaint: A reader asks why last week's front page story about a scrim result was published four hours before the scrim took place.
reply: Fish News was simply ahead of the news, as usual.

complaint: The council has written to dispute the headline "Council Says Not Emergency", stating it never said this.
reply: Fish News regards silence as a form of agreement and will not be revising the headline.

complaint: A reader asks why the correction to last month's correction contained a further error.
reply: Fish News has reviewed the correction to the correction and found no fault with either.

complaint: A reader requests that Fish News stop describing routine equipment deliveries as 'huge for base infrastructure'.
reply: Fish News's editorial standards on the word 'huge' remain under permanent review and will not be changing.

complaint: A reader notes that the salmon signal has never been technically explained despite four separate articles.
reply: Fish News considers the signal explained by the fact that it continues.
